facts.statement: Free Realms' one-year anniversary was celebrated on April 28, 2010.
facts.quote: will celebrate its one-year anniversary this month on April 28th

article_summaries.title: Free Realms Surpasses 10 Million Users and Prepares for 1st Birthday
article_summaries.summary: A Ten Ton Hammer press-release repost announcing that Free Realms had passed 10 million registered users and was preparing a one-year anniversary celebration on April 28, 2010. It says party decorations would appear in game from mid-April, along with new community events, minigames and 15 new birthday quests. It names no quests or rewards.
